Goal: Always select TAB

Currently it is possible for the use to not have Session-Manager selected tab. that break some of the feature, the Home tab is permant and should be the starting tab if nothing else exist. Otherweise the 'Active Tab' is remembered so that if session-manager is closed it can be resumed. Ensure a consist place for session-mamanger-operation/general (or non tab specic) operations exista as well. All operations and patters should be well documented with their own ReadMe MDs these are equivalent to some case of database contracts with jsons

Reference: /home/bilko/Projects/session-manager/session-manager-operations/prompt-sessions/attachments/82ppe8fyl4i-image.png

Both PRDs are queued and independent (can run in parallel):

- **866** `reconcile-tab-scoped-nav-empty-state` (~15 min) — fixes the exact bug in the screenshot: `ProjectsWorkspace.tsx` (File Explorer) renders a dead "No session selected." state whenever the session `activeTabId` is null while it's focused, because `useSessions().activeTabId` and `useLayout().focusedPanelId` are two independent stores with no reconciliation. Adds a guard that auto-navigates back to Home when File Explorer is focused with no active tab — scoped narrowly so it doesn't disturb Epics' intentional null-tab render or Browser/Editor's independent tab state.
- **867** `ops-namespace-readme-contracts` (~20 min) — adds README.md "data contracts" to `prompt-sessions`, `scheduler`, and `project-brief` (matching `feedback/README.md`'s structure), and resolves the "general namespace" question by documenting why `architecture/`, `design-mocks/`, `HUMAN_LEARN/`, `reviews/` are deliberately outside the single-writer OWNERS system (skill-authored artifacts, not app-owned runtime state) rather than inventing a namespace nobody currently writes to.

Both will run headlessly via the scheduler; I'm not able to babysit them to completion within this one-shot turn, so I'm not starting a monitoring loop — check the Scheduler tab for status, or ask me to review results in a follow-up session.

make sure that errors from each tab are getting pulled into a common place in operations /logs and have many tags associated with each log line so that it can be traced and alayzed start with logging various errors that pop up in the app consistenyl. Implement this yourself

Everything is clean and passing. Summary of what's implemented (not queued — done directly in this session, as asked):

**New `logs` ops namespace** — a common, per-project place where errors from any tab funnel in, tagged for tracing:
- `src/main/lib/opsErrorLog.cjs` — sole writer, appends structured JSONL lines to `<cwd>/session-manager-operations/logs/errors-<date>.jsonl`. Each line carries `level`, `scope`, `tabId`, `epicId`, an auto+caller-merged `tags[]` array, `message`, and redacted `meta`.
- `src/main/lib/opsOwnership.cjs` — registered `'logs': 'logs'` in the single-writer `OWNERS` map, fail-closed like every other namespace.
- `session-manager-operations/logs/README.md` — the data-contract doc (line shape, ownership, how to query with `jq`).

**Wired into real, consistently-firing error sites:**
- `src/main/pty.cjs` — PTY spawn failures and immediate-exit crashes (per-tab, per-project).
- `src/main/chatRunner.cjs` — every headless chat-run error funnels through the single `emitTerminal` chokepoint, so all 6 error paths (spawn failure, kill-ceiling timeout, unexpected result, stream error, unclean exit) are covered by one edit.
- Renderer plumbing extended end-to-end: `logger.ts` → `preload/index.cjs` → `logs.cjs`'s `log:write` handler now accept an optional `{cwd, tabId, epicId, tags}` context, forwarding to `opsErrorLog` when present. Applied to 4 real call sites in `GlobalSearchModal.tsx`/`QuickOpenModal.tsx`.

**Verified:** `npm run typecheck` clean, `npm run lint:selectors` clean, `node -c` syntax-check on every edited `.cjs`, and a new `src/main/__tests__/opsErrorLog.test.cjs` (4 passing tests) covering the write shape, redaction, no-cwd no-op, and tag de-duplication.

This is a starting rollout, not full coverage — most `console.error`/`log.error` call sites across the app (voice, speech recognition, scheduler, watchers, etc.) aren't wired yet since they don't currently have `cwd`/`tabId` readily in scope; extending coverage there is natural follow-up work but wasn't required to prove the mechanism end-to-end.
